references.text: The genealogy from Adam to Noah, showing humanity's history and God's plan through generations, parallel to Jesus' genealogy which shows his human origin through Joseph.
The genealogy from Adam to Noah emphasizes the importance of family lines in the Bible, which is also relevant for Jesus' lineage.
God's promise of a king from David's line, pointing forward to Jesus as the Messiah.
The prophecy about a virgin who will give birth to a son points to Jesus' miraculous birth and his divine origin.
Matthew's genealogy showing Jesus' lineage from Abraham through David to Joseph, parallel to Luke's account of Jesus' family line.
